description:
Install Docker Engine + the compose plugin on the box (official Docker apt repo), enable
    docker.service. Idempotent (no-ops if already present). This is the Docker-track counterpart of
    base_provision - use it INSTEAD of the native base_provision when you want the multi-version
    (containerized) mode. dry_run shows the script; confirm runs it.
name: docker_base_provision
